title: Plan a reversible observe-only control mode that keeps ordinary turns out of control admission
outcome: Plan a reversible observe-only control mode that keeps ordinary turns out of control admission
acceptance: A design note covers: today's advisory/turn_gated/action_gated behaviour on both Engram and TermAl sides; the pass-through contract (turns not withheld, diagnostics and evidence retained, what is lost); the narrow hard-blocking cases or none, with justification; the mode switch owner, knob, reversibility and in-flight grant handling; and migration and validation scope including whether a store-format change is needed

Both coordinators (Engram::Fable and Termal::Fable2) have reviewed the plan and it has been sent to Engram::Advisor for Greg's decision; no global runtime configuration is changed before that decision
disposal_reason: Overtaken on Greg's word (Asistant #239): gating was removed rather than switched to an observe-only mode, so no mode plan is needed.
